faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: How is this MRP different from Excel?
faq.a1: It nets usable stock (excluding lots waiting for QC), adds what is arriving from purchase orders and work orders, and offsets by each item's lead time. The result is a list of buy and make proposals you can turn into documents with one click, and the next run does not propose them again.
faq.q2: Do we have to change our accounting software?
faq.a2: No. The system does not do accounting. Today it exports data as files; connectors for Express, PEAK and FlowAccount are in development.
faq.q3: How safe is our company's data?
faq.a3: Each company is a separate tenant and the database enforces the separation with Row-Level Security on every table, not only in application code. Sign-in supports two-factor authentication, and nobody can approve their own request.
faq.a4: Yes. Every web page works on a phone, and there is an app for warehouse work such as receiving, issuing, counting and barcode scanning that keeps working offline and syncs when back online.
faq.q5: Can a contract manufacturer (OEM) use it?
faq.a5: Yes for inventory, purchasing, BOM and MRP. Tracking an order as a job, sending work to subcontractors and profit per order are next on the roadmap.
faq.a6: You can start the same day if your item list and BOMs are ready. Today data is entered on the web; Excel import is being built so you see results from day one.
